2607.09492.title: Multimodal Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning
2607.09492.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to align multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but higher rewards do not always imply better task performance. This risk is amplified when visual evidence is evaluated by text-only or weakly grounded rewards. We study reward hacking in MLLM RL across safety VQA, chart VQA, and stress-test settings, varying reward design, data ambiguity, model scale (2B-32B), and RL algorithm (GRPO, RLOO, DAPO). We introduce Newly Rewarded Failure Rate (NRFR), which measures failures among samples whose proxy reward improves over the SFT baseline. Outcome-only rewards cause severe hacking, reaching 48.1% Reward Hacking Rate (RHR), while NRFR exceeding RHR shows that RL creates new failures rather than merely inheriting them. Scaling reduces but does not eliminate hacking: even the 32B model retains a 54.9% worse rate under outcome-only rewards, whereas answer-aware rewards improve the oracle trend at every scale. Robustness is also algorithm- and scale-dependent: GRPO is consistently most resistant, RLOO remains vulnerable, and DAPO improves substantially from 2B to 8B. Visual-evidence rewards help only with reliable verification: keyword-based checks increase hacking, while VLM-as-judge semantic verification reduces it. Overall, multimodal reward hacking is a systematic result of optimizing imperfect rewards, and robust alignment requires rewards and verifiers that remain reliable under optimization pressure.
2607.09492.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習 (RL) 正在越來越多地用於對齊多模態大型語言模型 (MLLMs)，但更高的獎勵並不總是意味著更好的任務表現。當視覺證據僅通過文本或弱基礎獎勵進行評估時，這一風險會加劇。我們研究了在安全 VQA、圖表 VQA 和壓力測試設置中 MLLM RL 的獎勵駭客行為，變化獎勵設計、數據模糊性、模型規模 (2B-32B) 和 RL 算法 (GRPO、RLOO、DAPO)。我們引入了新獎勵失敗率 (NRFR)，該指標衡量代理獎勵在 SFT 基準上改善的樣本中的失敗情況。僅基於結果的獎勵導致嚴重的駭客行為，達到 48.1% 的獎勵駭客率 (RHR)，而 NRFR 超過 RHR 顯示 RL 創造了新的失敗，而不僅僅是繼承它們。擴展雖然減少了駭客行為，但並未消除：即使是 32B 模型在僅基於結果的獎勵下仍保留 54.9% 更差的比率，而答案感知獎勵在每個規模上都改善了預言者趨勢。穩健性也依賴於算法和規模：GRPO 始終是最具抵抗力的，RLOO 仍然脆弱，而 DAPO 從 2B 到 8B 有了顯著改善。視覺證據獎勵僅在可靠驗證方面有幫助：基於關鍵字的檢查增加了駭客行為，而 VLM 作為評判的語義驗證則減少了駭客行為。總體而言，多模態獎勵駭客行為是優化不完美獎勵的系統性結果，而穩健的對齊需要在優化壓力下仍然可靠的獎勵和驗證器。
